name: a comment connects to an automated reply and capture
looks: On a bold colour field, one small comment card sits alone under a claim. A connector line draws out from it to a second card labelled as an automation running, then to a third card delivering a resource, with a small captured-status tag popping in at the end.
build: annotated-diagram-overlay's leader-line build: each dashed or solid connector draws with strokeDashoffset between cards, the next card fading in right as its connector lands, ending with a small status chip (a check, a captured tag) popping on back.out.
sound: A tick per connector landing, a soft confirm chime on the final status tag.
prompt: On a bold colour field, show one small trigger card (a comment, a click, a message) connecting by a drawn line to an automation card, then to an outcome card, each line landing before the next card appears. End on a small status tag confirming the result was captured, to make an automated funnel visible as one connected path.
